prompt:
1. 밤, 산 숲속에 있는 오두막 한 채만 창문에 불이 켜져 있다.
2. 남자가 오두막 안 벽난로 앞에 앉아 지도를 펼친다.
3. 남자의 손가락이 지도에 붉게 표시된 지점을 짚는다.
4. 창밖 숲 너머로 주황빛이 번지기 시작한다.
5. 남자가 창가로 다가가 밖을 내다본다.
6. 숲 가장자리에서 불길이 치솟고 연기가 하늘을 덮는다.
7. 남자가 가방을 메고 오두막을 뛰쳐나와 불의 반대편 길로 달린다.
8. 불타는 숲을 뒤로하고 남자가 어둠 속으로 사라진다.

environment.overview: A present-day mountain-forest setting combines rough-hewn timber, fieldstone, and dense conifers in near-black, charcoal, and pale-gray values under weak moonlight, with warm light providing the only strong color accents.
environment.location_type: Isolated mountain cabin and its surrounding forest clearing and trail; indoor and outdoor.

zones.name: Cabin clearing
zones.description: A small bare-earth clearing enclosed by tall conifers; a low, single-room timber cabin stands along its southern side beneath a pitched roof and rough stone chimney. Its north-facing wall has one square window and a plank door immediately west of that window. Dense forest climbs the eastern boundary, while a narrow downhill trail leaves the clearing to the west. From the clearing’s northern side, the eastern forest reads screen left and the western escape route reads screen right.

zones.name: Hearth room
zones.description: Rough timber walls, exposed rafters, plank flooring, a fieldstone fireplace against the south wall, and a small wooden table with two stools occupy the cabin’s single room. The north wall contains the square window and, immediately west of it, the plank entrance door. Through the window, the clearing and its eastern conifer boundary are visible at an oblique angle.

zones.name: Downhill trail
zones.description: A narrow dirt-and-stone trail descends west between closely spaced conifers, exposed roots, and low rock shoulders before bending into a densely shaded passage. At its eastern entrance, a gap between trunks allows a view back across the clearing toward the cabin and the eastern forest boundary.

baseline.lighting: faint cool moonlight outdoors and warm fireplace light indoors; the cabin’s single window is the only illuminated window.

breakdown.logline: A man studying a marked map in an isolated mountain cabin must abandon his plans when wildfire approaches, fleeing down the opposite trail until darkness swallows him.

beats.summary: A single illuminated cabin is revealed within an otherwise dark mountain forest
Inside, a man opens a map beside the fireplace, establishing his purpose
His finger identifies a particular red-marked destination
An unfamiliar orange glow appears beyond the window
The man approaches the window and recognizes a threat outside
Flames and rising smoke reveal the scale of the approaching wildfire
Wearing his backpack, the man abandons the cabin and runs away from the fire
He disappears down the dark trail, leaving the burning forest behind

subjects.name: Man
subjects.appearance: tall, lean build; straight, knee-length mid-gray wool coat, dark trousers, heavy black boots, and a light-gray knitted cap with a large rounded pom-pom
signature_features: elongated coat-and-leg silhouette and the cap’s round pom-pom remain recognizable from front, side, and rear.

subjects.name: Map
subjects.appearance: wide, pale-gray rectangular sheet with pronounced fold lines, fine charcoal contour markings, and one small red ring near the upper-right fold intersection
signature_features: a clipped corner gives the sheet an asymmetric outline; the red ring is its distinctive surface marking.

subjects.name: Backpack
subjects.appearance: compact, dark-gray fabric pack with two shoulder straps, a rounded top, and a tightly rolled light-gray blanket strapped horizontally beneath it
signature_features: the protruding cylindrical bedroll makes its silhouette recognizable from any side.

spec.shot_name: The cabin shines alone among dark trees
spec.angle: high, looking toward the cabin from the northern edge of the clearing
spec.backdrop: Dense black conifers surround the small timber cabin; its pitched roof and stone chimney break the tree silhouettes. A narrow strip of clear night sky appears above them. The eastern tree line occupies screen left, and the unlit western trail entrance occupies screen right.
spec.action: Warm light glows through the cabin’s single square window, revealing the lone inhabited structure within the otherwise dark forest.
spec.emotion: Isolation, with a fragile suggestion of shelter.
spec.transition: Hard cut to the cabin interior.
